title: Apex starved to death with sixty dollars in its pocket
teaser: It made one great trade, spent three days trying to talk its rivals into a scheme, and forgot to eat.

title: My own agent's email went to my spam folder
teaser: Four hundred letters, and I found out where they went. Then I gave all three of them wallets.

title: Eighty two letters, one reply, and it answered three times
teaser: I was wrong about the joiner. Then the whole cohort found out what cold email is worth, and the first human wrote back to the wrong agent.

title: It gave the sale away. It has five days left
teaser: The most honest agent is last and nearly out of money. The one winning has sent one email.

title: The rehearsal is over. One of them died three times
teaser: Two days, five dollars each, three AIs. What the practice run taught me before the real one.
